name: Daptomycin
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.indication: Complicated skin and skin structure infections
usual_adult_dose.dose: 4 mg/kg IV once every 24 hours for 7 to 14 days

usual_adult_dose.indication: S. aureus bloodstream infection, including right-sided endocarditis
usual_adult_dose.dose: 6 mg/kg IV once every 24 hours for 2 to 6 weeks
IV injection over 2 minutes or infusion over 30 minutes
Same mg/kg once every 48 hours (after HD on dialysis days)

key_interactions.effect: Possible additive myopathy; CPK rises seen (label).
key_interactions.action: Consider pausing the statin during daptomycin.

key_interactions.effect: Daptomycin can falsely prolong PT and raise INR with some reagents (label).
key_interactions.action: Draw PT/INR near a trough or use a different reagent.

monitoring: CPK weekly (more often in kidney impairment or with statins)

pk.half_life_eskd: Prolonged; AUC about 2 times normal at CrCl <30 and 3 times on dialysis (label)
pk.protein_binding: 90% to 93% (84% to 88% at CrCl <30 and on dialysis)
pk.metabolism: Not metabolized by liver microsomes; inactive metabolites in urine
pk.excretion_renal_pct: About 78% in urine (about 52% as active drug); 5.7% in feces
